description: Ministry of Education, High Education and Vocational Education - Order Made under Sub- Section (1) of Section 27 Eastern University of Sri Lanka

It is a statutory instrument issued by a minister exercising powers vested by an existing law. While a minister's name and title are present, the primary purpose is not a government personnel change or a detailed assignment of ministerial portfolios, but the enactment of a legal order. Therefore, the specialized Legal/Regulatory classification takes precedence.
